e.title: Allstate Claims Severity
e.summary: 车险理赔严重度 Kaggle 经典竞赛：连续损失回归预测基准（特征工程标杆）
e.body: Allstate Claims Severity 是 Kaggle 经典车险竞赛：从 130+ 脱敏特征预测理赔损失（连续回归）——回归类特征工程的标杆竞赛。对 RIAA：车险严重度建模的经典基准——与 [[porto-seguro-competition]]（二分类出险）互补：一个分类、一个回归；与 [[fremtpl2]]（纯保费数据）对照连续损失视角；特征工程/正则化（Ridge/GBM 高分方案）的练兵场；配合 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定价）、[[tweedie-python]]（分布）做完整定价实验。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：Kaggle 竞赛页确认（Allstate 理赔严重度回归竞赛），未实测
e.summary_en: Classic Kaggle motor-claims-severity competition: continuous loss regression benchmark (feature-engineering benchmark)
e.summary_hk: 車險理賠嚴重度 Kaggle 經典競賽：連續損失回歸預測基準（特徵工程標杆）
e.body_en: Allstate Claims Severity is a classic Kaggle motor-insurance competition: predicting claim losses from 130+ anonymised features (continuous regression) — a benchmark competition for regression-style feature engineering. For RIAA: the classic benchmark of motor-severity modelling — complementing [[porto-seguro-competition]] (binary claim/no-claim): one is classification, one is regression; contrast the continuous-loss view with [[fremtpl2]] (pure-premium data); a training ground for feature engineering/regularisation (Ridge/GBM top solutions); with [[machine-learning-pricing]] (ML pricing) and [[tweedie-python]] (distributions) run complete pricing experiments.
e.body_hk: Allstate Claims Severity 是 Kaggle 經典車險競賽：從 130+ 脱敏特徵預測理賠損失（連續回歸）——回歸類特徵工程的標杆競賽。對 RIAA：車險嚴重度建模的經典基準——與 [[porto-seguro-competition]]（二分類出險）互補：一個分類、一個回歸；與 [[fremtpl2]]（純保費數據）對照連續損失視角；特徵工程/正則化（Ridge/GBM 高分方案）的練兵場；配合 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定價）、[[tweedie-python]]（分佈）做完整定價實驗。
